positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: how does the async remember contract structure return, extraction, and reaction delivery without a blocking call?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under one directional read of the async job contract for remember: src-1 ratifies the receipt-and-cursor-polling shape with no blocking call and no lost work on a dropped receipt, while src-2 asserts the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback decision. Together they span the contract's return, extraction-watching, and reaction-delivery mechanics.
